description: This file defines the ViewNewsLetterList class, which extends ViewList, for rendering and processing the newsletter list view within the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for handling search forms and preparing the display, specifically filtered for 'NewsLetter' campaign types.

classes.name: ViewNewsLetterList
classes.description: A class extending ViewList to manage the display and filtering of newsletter campaigns within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: processSearchForm
methods.description: Handles populating and building search criteria for the newsletter list, with a filter for campaign type 'NewsLetter'.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the display by setting module strings for the newsletter list view.
